seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [player,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x1, x x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player A1-4 turns and moves 4; a box, the wall, the chaser or the board edge blocks it. A5 toggles the box in front between faced and grabbed.
A grabbed box moves with the player. That answers the hypothesis: block A4 x vs no_change is decided by its tag (grabbed vs idle/faced).
Chaser: seeks the nearest BFS-reachable idle unseated box from its right side, moving greedily x-first; grabs it (carried), drags it to the nearest empty slot (seated/filled), then releases.
Wall: hatched period-4 column. Boxes may enter it and hide its pixels. Boxes are renamed box_i by (y,x). Stateless.
Unconfirmed: grabbed moves sideways or backwards (facing kept), chaser stuck on both axes, A6/A7 (player no-op, chaser still ticks).
